player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Player {player_id} wɔ GameOfPureStrategy akansi mu.
- Wo wɔ 13 kaadi A-K; biara betumi ayɛ adwuma kakraa.
- Ɔsram biara kaadi anidie bɛda adi. Di kaadi kakraa biako pɛ kwa wɔ bracketed token te sɛ '[Q]', '[10]', '[2]' ...
- Kaadi kɛseɛ na ɛdi nkonim wɔ anidie no so (plus carry-over). Tie no bɛtwe anidie no mu sɛ pot maa ɔsram a edi hɔ.
- Ɔha kɛseɛ a wɔadi nkonim wɔ ɔsram 13 akyi na ɛdi nkonim.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ɛsɛ sɛ dwumadi no fa krataa a wɔaka ho asɛm ato hɔ AFOTRA mu.
